title: Senior Reinforcement Learning Engineer
description:
Gravis Robotics is a high-growth Series A start-up backed by SoftBank, bringing Physical AI to the construction industry, turning heavy construction machines into autonomous robots.
Gravis began as an ETH Zurich spin-out, and our unique combination of learning-based automation and augmented remote control lets one operator safely conduct a fleet of earthmoving machines in a gamified environment.

Backed by deep robotics research and now deployed across multiple countries with leading construction and equipment partners, our team is rapidly growing to bring this technology to a trillion-dollar industry.

The Gravis RACK is a machine-agnostic retrofit kit that adds autonomy to excavators and wheel loaders from 10 to 100+ tonnes: LiDAR and camera sensing, GNSS RTK, networking hardware and rugged edge compute that works offline. Paired with the Slate tablet and our Copilot software, it lets an operator run a machine manually, with AI assistance, or fully autonomously. The autonomy team at Gravis builds autonomous systems for excavators operating in real construction environments. title: Senior WordPress Backend Developer

Our clients and nonprofit partners are committed to creating positive social change-and we pour every ounce of our passion and skill into helping them succeed.

title: Senior Nuclear Criticality Safety Engineer
description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a Senior Nuclear Criticality Safety Engineer to join our team. 

Position Description

A Senior Nuclear Criticality Safety Engineer at Oklo is responsible for performing criticality safety evaluations, developing the nuclear criticality safety basis, and architecting the nuclear criticality safety program for a first-of-a-kind used nuclear fuel recycling facility.

Specific responsibilities may include:

• Identifying and evaluating nuclear criticality safety (NCS) hazards for fuel cycle facilities

• Performing criticality safety evaluations (CSEs) to demonstrate subcriticality under normal and credible abnormal conditions

• Developing the criticality code validation report

• Demonstrating compliance with the double-contingency principle

• Documenting criticality hazard analyses, CSEs, and supporting technical information

• Evaluating and implementing controlled parameters for the NCS program

• Developing the criticality accident alarm system and inadvertent criticality emergency response plan

• Supporting safety basis development and licensing efforts

• Developing and administering the NCS program, methodologies, and management measures

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelors, Masters, or PhD in nuclear engineering, chemical engineering, or chemistry, or related field

• Minimum 5+ years experience performing CSEs as a part of a nuclear facility’s safety basis

Bonus Qualifications:

• Knowledge of used nuclear fuel recycling technologies

• 10+ years of experience performing criticality safety evaluations for an NRC licensed fuel cycle facility

Competencies

We are looking for a Senior Nuclear Criticality Safety Engineer that is:

• Knowledge of nuclear science, physics of criticality, and chemistry

• Knowledge of nuclear fuel cycle processes and nuclear fuel cycle facility accident scenarios

• Proficient with Attila4MC, MCNP, SCALE, and/or Serpent codes and modules

• Familiarity with critical experiments and their purpose

• Knowledge of criticality-specific codes, standards, regulatory requirements, and industry practices for nuclear fuel cycle facilities

• Familiarity with NUREG-1513, NUREG-1520, NUREG/CR-6410, NUREG/CR-6698, NUREG/CR-7311, and NRC RG 3.71

• Passionate about clean energy and making advanced fission a reality

• Knowledgeable about structural design, analysis, and construction

• Eager to work on a dynamic team, receive constructive feedback, and grow with us

• Willing to think differently and learn quickly

• Comfortable in a fast-paced, highly iterative startup environment

• Excited to think creatively, critically, and reflectively about the problems they are solving, while not leaning only on what has been done before 

• An excellent writer who can communicate technical concepts in modern active voice

Who you are:

A startup person : You aren't driven by titles or hierarchy, and prefer efficiency to excess process. You don't need or expect to have a lot of guidance but you enjoy working in a fast-paced team. If you prefer the culture and feel of a large organization, that is great, but you likely won’t enjoy working with us! There is plenty of important work and plenty of good opportunities with organizations like that.

Motivated : You are self-motivated. You bring an enthusiasm to the team, and imbue a sense of passion that goes beyond clocking in and clocking out. This isn’t about a fake or arbitrary “pieces of flair” mentality or lack of work-life balance! It is about being a part of the vision and feeling a part of reaching team goals.

A team-player : Oklo genuinely is a team. We aren’t about taking credit for ourselves, and we aren’t about pushing blame to others. We do incredible things because we work as a team.

An excellent communicator : We need a person who is not only technically competent but also a clear and upbeat communicator.

title: Team Lead (m/w/d) Field Sales - Dortmund
description:
Möchtest du deine Sales-Fähigkeiten an andere weitergeben und für das Wachstum von Salonkee in [REGION] verantwortlich sein? Bei uns bekommst du ein strukturiertes Management-Onboarding, ein eigenes Team, das du weiter ausbaust, sowie Verantwortung und Vertrauen.

Salonkee ist Marktführer für Salon-Software in Luxemburg, Belgien und der Schweiz. Über 10.000 Beauty- und Wellness-Betriebe in sieben Ländern nutzen unsere All-in-one-Software - von der Terminbuchung über die Kundenverwaltung und die Kasse bis hin zu Marketing- und KI-Funktionen.

Für einen Salon bedeutet das im Schnitt 70 % weniger Terminausfälle und 8 bis 12 Stunden weniger Verwaltungsaufwand pro Woche.

DEINE ROLLE:

- Team aufbauen und entwickeln: Du startest entweder als erstes Teammitglied oder mit einem kleinen Team, das du weiter ausbaust.

- Du entwickelst dein Team durch Coaching, Shadowing und Roleplays - nicht nur durch Steuerung & Monitoring.

- Lead by Example: In der Aufbauphase gewinnst du auch selbst Neukund:innen, mit einem klar definierten eigenen Zielanteil. So kennst du den Markt aus erster Hand.

- Präsenz im Markt: Du begleitest dein Team zu Terminen, unterstützt in der Akquise und überzeugst live in Demos.

- Du steuerst datenbasiert - über KPIs und Pipeline. Du kennst die Zahlen deiner Teammitglieder und leitest daraus frühzeitig Maßnahmen ab.

- Struktur und Rhythmus: Du organisierst die Woche, führst 1:1-Gespräche, löst Hindernisse schnell und sorgst für saubere Arbeit im CRM.

- Du entwickelst deine Region strategisch weiter und wirkst an der Optimierung unserer Vertriebsprozesse mit.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

- Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Vertrieb, davon nachweisbar im Außendienst (Field Sales) mit eigener Abschlussverantwortung.

- Nachweisbare Erfolge in der Neukundengewinnung: Du kannst mit Zahlen belegen, was du erreicht hast und woran du festmachst, dass du darin gut bist.

- Führungserfahrung ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Wichtiger ist, dass du die Fähigkeiten hast, deine Teammitglieder zu entwickeln und für Wachstum zu sorgen. Relevante Erfahrungen in den Bereichen Mentoring, Onboarding neuer Kolleg:innen oder in Projekten sind hilfreich.

- Datenaffinität: Du arbeitest sicher mit KPIs, Pipeline und Forecast und leitest daraus Entscheidungen ab.

- Du bist sicher im Umgang mit digitalen Tools.

- Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du planst deine Region eigenständig und setzt klare Prioritäten.

- Verhandlungssicheres bis muttersprachliches Deutsch sowie gute Englischkenntnisse.

- Führerschein der Klasse B und Freude daran, in deiner Region unterwegs zu sein.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

- Führungskräfte-Entwicklung von Tag 1: Unsere Sales Manager Academy begleitet dich beim Einstieg in die Führungsrolle - gerade dann, wenn es dein erstes Team ist.

- Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Du entscheidest mit, wen du einstellst und wie dein Team arbeitet.

- Ein Vergütungspaket, das Team- und Eigenleistung honoriert: attraktives Fixum plus ungedeckelte Provision.

- Klare KPIs & Performance-Transparenz, damit du jederzeit weißt, wo du stehst.

- Eigenverantwortliche Wochenplanung und Vertrauensarbeitszeit.

- Firmenwagen inkl. Tankkarte sowie MacBook und iPhone.

- 50 € steuerfreies Guthaben pro Monat über Probonio.

- Teamevents, die ihren Namen verdienen: Sommerfest, Winterfeier und regelmäßige Teamformate.

WIE GEHT ES WEITER?

1. Bewerbung & Sichtung - wir melden uns so schnell wie möglich bei dir.

2. Erstgespräch mit unserem Recruiting-Team (ca. 30-45 Minuten).

3. Video-Call mit deiner künftigen Führungskraft.

4. Field Day - zwei Stunden bei uns im Office. Du siehst, wie wir arbeiten, wir sehen dich in Aktion.

5. Abschlussgespräch mit unserer Head of Sales.

Salonkee steht für Chancengleichheit und Vielfalt. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen, Perspektiven und Fähigkeiten - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter, Behinderung, Religion oder Identität.

title: Principal Web Solutions Strategist
description:
About OHO

OHO is a digital agency full of smart, curious learners who love solving complex problems for higher education organizations. We partner with colleges and universities to navigate digital complexity so their marketing drives measurable impact for their brand and enrollment goals.
We bring deep expertise and a consultative mindset to everything we do-asking the right questions, challenging assumptions when needed, and always centering around our clients’ goals. In this role, you’ll be the subject-matter expert who frames the solution as part of the win-strategy for higher-ed web solutions engagements, helping prospective clients understand where they’re stuck and advising them on the right path forward, not just pitching a product.
We’re building toward a future where OHO is higher education’s most trusted advisory and implementation partner, and this role sits on the front lines of that journey-translating institutional challenges into smart, actionable web strategies.
About the Position
At its core, this role exists to win business: owning win-strategy, shaping the story OHO tells, engaging directly with clients, and leading pitches and proposals for Web Solutions deals.
The Principal Web Solutions Strategist sits on OHO ’s Web Solutions Strategy team and plays a critical role at the intersection of business development, strategy, and delivery, in close partnership with the Director of Strategy. This role leads the strategic definition of Web Solutions deals, from early conversations with prospective clients through high-level involvement during delivery-ensuring that what OHO sells is thoughtful, viable, and aligned with how we deliver value.
In the sales process, the Principal Web Solutions Strategist crafts and communicates the vision and then defines the solution. You will own the majority of strategic airtime in client conversations:

• Properly diagnosing client pain points and goals

• Leading pitches and proposal strategy

• Creating proposals and pitch materials, bringing in subject-matter experts and delivery leads when specialized input is needed or the opportunity requires a custom deliverable

• Presenting audits and strategic recommendations

• Clearly explaining OHO ’s approach and the “how” behind our work

Proposal and pitch work is core to this role. It’s strategic work, not just production work. You’ll set the direction and narrative, developing customized proposals and pitch materials that communicate a persuasive, tailored solution that meets the client’s needs while effectively communicating the value OHO would bring to the engagement.
You’ll work closely with OHO ’s Sales and Web Solutions teams, collecting collaborative input and feedback as you build the final proposal or pitch for delivery.
Through deep expertise in higher education websites and digital ecosystems, you’ll build trust quickly and confidently answer complex technical and strategic questions, partnering with OHO subject matter experts as needed.
After a project is won, you’ll stay engaged at key moments to ensure the project direction stays aligned with the vision established during the sales process. You’ll support a strong transition into delivery, participate in select milestones where your context is most valuable, and be available to help flag major strategic misalignments or risks so the team can address them early. This role provides continuity and confidence for the client at pivotal points while empowering the delivery team to lead day-to-day strategy and execution.
Beyond individual projects, you’ll help shape the evolution of OHO ’s Web Solutions practice. You’ll gather market insights, identify buyer patterns, and partner with our Web Solutions leadership team to shape, inform and refine our offerings and how we talk about the value we bring to potential partners. i You’ll also contribute to OHO ’s thought leadership so that OHO continues to be seen as a trusted strategic partner for higher education institutions.

description:

Radiant is looking for a senior social media and communications leader who can turn deep technical substance into public narrative, executive voice and market momentum.

The right candidate is a high-agency B2B technology storyteller: technically curious, editorially sharp, deeply fluent in social media, and resourceful enough to build a steady pipeline of speaking opportunities, conference submissions, podcast pitches, panels, awards, and executive visibility moments.

You should be comfortable operating in complex technical markets AI infrastructure, GPUs, datacenters, developer platforms, enterprise software or similar categories. You do not need to be an engineer, but you need to be able to sit with technical leaders, understand what matters, find the angle, and translate it into language that is sharp, credible, and useful.

WHAT YOU’LL OWN

SOCIAL MEDIA STRATEGY & EXECUTION

You will own the company’s social presence across executive and corporate channels, with a particular focus on LinkedIn and other platforms where technical buyers, partners, investors, customers, and industry influencers spend time.

You will develop the strategy, write the content, shape the voice, test formats, track performance, and build a social engine that is sharp, intelligent, and distinctive. This includes company posts, executive posts, technical POVs, event coverage, launch support, partner amplification, customer moments, recruiting content, and timely commentary on industry developments.

EXECUTIVE VOICE & THOUGHT LEADERSHIP

You will help build and sharpen the public voices of the company’s executives and technical leaders. That means developing points of view, ghostwriting posts, preparing talking points, identifying timely angles, and turning internal conviction into external narrative.

TECHNICAL COMMUNICATIONS

You will work closely with product marketing, product, engineering, infrastructure, sales, partnerships and leadership to understand what the company is building and why it matters.

You will translate technical topics into clear, compelling communications for the market. This may include short-form social content, executive posts, speaking abstracts, event messaging, award submissions, customer stories, and thought-leadership themes.

You should know how to ask good questions, pressure-test claims, avoid hype, and make technical content accessible without making it shallow.

SPEAKING, AWARDS & OPPORTUNITY PIPELINE

You will build and manage a proactive speaking and visibility engine for the company and its executives.

We expect a consistent weekly motion: sourcing opportunities, drafting abstracts, preparing submissions, pitching panels, finding podcasts, tracking deadlines, managing speaker assets, and creating a calendar of external visibility opportunities.

The expectation is not that every submission turns into a talk. The expectation is that the opportunity pipeline is always moving.

TOOLS, ANALYTICS & LEVERAGE

You should be fluent with modern marketing, social, research, writing, analytics, AI, design, video, transcript, and workflow tools. We are looking for someone who uses tools to move faster, test more ideas, repurpose better, and increase output quality without adding process drag. You should be comfortable measuring what works, identifying patterns, and improving the system over time.

You have 7-10+ years of experience in B2B technology communications, social media, content, executive communications, PR, thought leadership, or a closely related function.

You have worked in technical markets and can show that you understand how to communicate complex products, platforms, or infrastructure to sophisticated audiences.

You are an exceptional writer with strong editorial judgment.

You are social-native, not social-adjacent. You understand hooks, formats, timing, voice, audience behavior, and what makes technical content travel.

title: React Native Mobile Application Developer

title: Product Engineer, Business Operations
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. title: Machine Learning Engineer

We’re on a mission to transform how companies use data. Come be a part of our journey!

The AI/ML Engineering team builds and operates ClickHouse's AI and machine learning products end-to-end. - Feature Development: Design and implement AI-powered features across the full stack, from backend inference services to intuitive frontend interfaces within the ClickHouse Cloud platform.

- Technical Integration: Integrate models into production systems with proper monitoring, versioning, observability, and evaluation.

- Oncall: Participate in the daytime oncall rotation along with the rest of the team.

- ML Engineering: Own the ML pipeline end to end (data, training, evaluation), and fine-tune or train custom models when off-the-shelf ones fall short. Track the state of the art closely enough to apply what genuinely improves our products.

- 5+ years of software engineering experience in production environments

- Exposure to working directly with AI/ML technologies

- Experience integrating and deploying AI/ML models in production systems, including working with inference APIs and vector databases

- A high level of ownership and can drive features from concept to production with minimal supervision

- Ability to thrive in collaborative environments and can effectively communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders

- Applied ML experience in Python (Jupyter, PyTorch, common ML libraries), hands-on with compute clusters (Ray, Slurm), and designs trustworthy experiments to drive architectural decisions

Nice to have

- Familiarity with cloud technologies such as AWS, Azure, or GCP, particularly services related to AI/ML deployment

- Understanding of database systems and data processing pipelines, with ClickHouse experience being a significant plus

- Experience with embedding-based systems (retrieval, ranking, recommenders) and the representation-learning ideas underneath them

PERKS

- Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

title: Warehouse & Inventory Associate

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE DATA CENTER OPERATIONS TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Operate at the scale of a nation, not a building. Accelerating toward 10s to 100s of GWs by the end of the decade, more than the entire electricity consumption of many countries. You won't just run a data center; you'll run infrastructure the size of a G7.

- Fly the plane while it's being built. Running flawless operations inside a live construction zone, adapting in real time and turning the pace of build-out into our advantage. You will redefine operational excellence.

- Write the playbook, don't inherit it. Most operators step into someone else's system. Here you build one, leaving your fingerprints on how the whole company runs. As we scale 100x, you'll set the standards, shape the operating model, and grow the team by the thousands.

 

ROLE SCOPE

- Operate forklifts, pallet jacks, and other warehouse equipment safely to receive, move, stage, and ship critical infrastructure at high velocity.

- Load, unload, inspect, and organize incoming hardware, ensuring every shipment is accounted for and ready for deployment.

- Pick, pack, and deliver parts quickly and accurately so technicians and engineers always have what they need to keep the data center moving.

- Maintain an organized, clean, and deployment-ready warehouse, keeping inventory accessible and material flowing efficiently across the site.

- Support inventory counts, stock replenishment, and asset tracking with precision, helping maintain accurate inventory and preventing operational delays.

- Assist with packaging, returns, RMAs, and other warehouse operations while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, safety, and workflow.

 

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

title: Manager, Treasury (2026-8083)
description:
The Manager of Treasury is responsible for overseeing the organization's daily cash management activities, short- and medium-term liquidity forecasting, banking relationships and account structures, and cash reconciliation processes. This role is instrumental in maintaining adequate liquidity to support business operations, maximizing returns on excess cash, and minimizing financing and borrowing costs.
The position also leads treasury-related process optimization initiatives, leveraging NetSuite, the company's ERP platform, to enhance efficiency, strengthen internal controls, improve cash visibility, and support strategic financial decision-making. The Manager of Treasury collaborates closely with Finance, Accounting, and business leaders to ensure effective cash flow management and alignment with organizational financial objectives.
Must be able to work the East Coast hours of Monday-Friday 8:30am-5:00pm comfortably.
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
Daily Cash Management

• Manage and monitor daily cash activity across all operating and disbursement accounts

• Ensure cash is positioned in the correct bank accounts to meet operational needs and minimize idle balances

• Execute daily/weekly transfers between accounts as needed, including funding of disbursement accounts

• Support wire and ACH payment processing, including dual-approval controls

Cash Forecasting

• Prepare and maintain a rolling 13-week cash flow forecast, updated daily

• Analyze variances between forecasted and actual cash flows and adjust assumptions accordingly

• Forecast cash receipts and disbursements using AR/AP aging reports, historical trends, and knowledge of customer payment behavior and vendor payment terms

• Identify and clearly flag when borrowing or debt repayment will be needed based on projected cash position

• Partner with FP&A on liquidity assumptions for annual budget and long-range planning

Bank Structure & Reconciliation

• Assist in the design and implementation of a concentration account and zero balance account (ZBA) structure

• Perform or oversee reconciliation of all bank accounts (approximately 15 accounts), ensuring timely resolution of discrepancies

• Maintain relationships with banking partners and serve as a point of contact for day-to-day banking issues

Investment & Yield Optimization

• Research and recommend short-term investment vehicles (money market funds, sweep accounts, overnight investments, CDs, etc.) to maximize earnings on excess cash

• Monitor market rates and banking fee structures to ensure competitive terms

Debt & Credit Facility Management

• Manage debt covenant compliance monitoring

Internal Controls & Governance

• Maintain and enforce treasury-related internal controls (segregation of duties, approval hierarchies, fraud prevention/positive pay)

• Maintain treasury policies and procedures documentation

• Support audit requests (internal and external) related to cash and bank activity

Systems & Reporting

• Lead ongoing optimization of NetSuite treasury functions (cash management module, bank feeds, reconciliation automation) to drive efficiency and process improvement

• Prepare monthly treasury reporting package for senior leadership

• Evaluate and recommend treasury workstation or cash management technology tools.

The above duties are meant to be representative of the position and not all-inclusive.
MINIMUM JOB REQUIREMENTS:

• Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, or related field.

• Demonstrated experience managing multi-account bank structures and daily cash positioning.

• Experience building and maintaining rolling cash flow forecasts (13-week or similar).

• Strong understanding of AR/AP aging and its application to cash forecasting.

• Advanced Excel skills (pivot tables, complex formulas, financial modeling).

• Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE ENERGY TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Put solar, storage and gas in the ground at an install rate no one in the construction market has hit. We are building generation across multiple gigawatt sites at once, on a schedule traditional EPC delivery cannot meet.

- Secure supply at a scale and timeline the supply chain cannot meet, and reshore it ourselves. Cells, containers, transformers and turbines are all constrained, so we qualify new suppliers and stand up domestic capacity instead of waiting in line.

- Make solar, gas and storage combine into power steady enough to run AI workloads. A training run does not tolerate a dip, so the hybrid plant has to behave like firm generation even when the resource behind it does not.

- Clear balancing authority certification, firm load rights, permits and interconnection against long clocks and a shifting policy environment. These approvals sit on the critical path to every gigawatt, so we work them years ahead of the build.

ROLE SCOPE

- Own the production system behind how Fluidstack builds generation, from module fabrication through field install and energization, as one standard set of work instructions repeated across concurrent gigawatt sites.

- Set takt time and line balance for module and skid manufacturing, then hold the line to it with standard work, andon escalation and first-pass yield targets rather than with expediting.

- Drive install rate and rework down in the field through kaizen events and value stream mapping run with the crews doing the work, at the site, on the shift.

- Take quality to the source at suppliers through process audits, error-proofing and joint improvement work on their floor, and fold every fix into the standard design through change control so the next site inherits it.

- Teach the method across the organization, coaching engineers, site leads and contractors through A3 problem solving so the system holds when you are not in the room.

Wir suchen einen Product Manager, der diese Probleme verstehen und lösen will. Du gehst zu den Nutzern, erkennst gemeinsame Bedürfnisse über mehrere Verwaltungen hinweg und übersetzt deine Erkenntnisse in klare Prioritäten und konkrete Produktverbesserungen.

Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Engineering und Design zusammen. Du gestaltest die Richtung und kümmerst dich um die Details, die aus einer guten Idee ein funktionierendes Produkt machen.

WAS DU BEI UNS MACHST

- Nutzer und Arbeitsabläufe verstehen: Du beobachtest die Arbeit in unseren Hausverwaltungen und findest auch Probleme, die uns über Supportanfragen oder Online-Feedback bisher nicht erreichen.

- Gemeinsame Bedürfnisse erkennen: Du vergleichst Abläufe zwischen Verwaltungen und identifizierst Verbesserungen mit dem größten Nutzen.

- Die Roadmap gestalten: Du verbindest einzelne Projekte mit einer klaren Produktrichtung, begründest Prioritäten und machst sie für das Team verständlich.

- Lösungen entwickeln: Du recherchierst Alternativen, erarbeitest Vorschläge und durchdenkst Nutzerabläufe gemeinsam mit Engineering und Design.

- Zusammenhänge durchdringen: Du verstehst, wie Immobilien, Einheiten, Eigentümer, Dokumente und weitere Daten miteinander verbunden sind - und welche Folgen Änderungen an einer Stelle haben.

- Von der Idee bis zur Nutzung begleiten: Du lieferst die passende Detailtiefe für ein Projekt, klärst offene Fragen während der Entwicklung und überprüfst nach dem Release, ob die Verbesserung ankommt.

- KI praktisch einsetzen: Du nutzt Tools, um Produktverhalten zu untersuchen, Ideen auszuprobieren, Prototypen zu bauen und Tests zu unterstützen.

WAS DU MITBRINGST

- Erfahrung mit Software für reale Arbeitsabläufe: Beispielsweise aus ERP, Supply Chain, HR, CRM oder anderen komplexen Geschäftsprozessen. Du verstehst, dass Software bestehende Abläufe und Rahmenbedingungen berücksichtigen muss.

- Starke Discovery-Fähigkeiten: Du fragst präzise nach, gehst über den ersten Wunsch hinaus und findest heraus, welches Problem tatsächlich gelöst werden muss.

- Gutes Produkturteil: Du machst aus einer unübersichtlichen Ausgangslage eine klare Richtung, sinnvolle Prioritäten und verständliche Nutzerabläufe.

- Verständnis für verknüpfte Systeme: Du kannst Beziehungen zwischen Daten und die Auswirkungen von Veränderungen nachvollziehen.

- Praktische technische und KI-Kompetenz: Du kannst mit Tools ein System untersuchen und einen Prototypen bauen. Eigenständig produktionsreifen Code zu liefern, setzen wir nicht voraus.

- Eigenverantwortung und Teamfähigkeit: Du bringst klare Vorschläge ein, lässt sie hinterfragen und entwickelst mit anderen eine bessere Lösung.

- Eine pragmatische Arbeitsweise: Du kommst mit Unsicherheit zurecht, arbeitest dich in Details ein und bringst Dinge in einem kleinen Team voran.

Du musst noch kein Experte für Hausverwaltung sein. Du brauchst die Neugier und Fähigkeit, dich in diese Welt einzuarbeiten. Erfahrung in einem frühen Startup kann dafür ein guter Beleg sein - wir sind aber offen für unterschiedliche Hintergründe.

WARUM DU BEI BUENA EINSTEIGEN SOLLTEST

- Du bist nah am Problem: Du hast direkten Zugang zu unseren Nutzern und kannst überprüfen, ob deine Arbeit ihren Alltag verbessert.

- Du gestaltest das Produkt mit: In unserem kleinen Team haben deine Erkenntnisse und Entscheidungen direkten Einfluss darauf, was wir als Nächstes bauen.

- Du wächst mit deinem Beitrag: Gute Ergebnisse führen bei uns schnell zu mehr Verantwortung.

- Du arbeitest eng mit dem Team: Persönlicher Austausch und kurze Wege sind uns wichtig. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam aus unserem Büro in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg.

DEINE BENEFITS

- Büronähe wird belohnt: Bis zu 50

title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
description:
Position: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
About the Role
We are seeking an accomplished and commercially strategic Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead the financial strategy, financial performance, capital management, investment finance, treasury, reporting, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investment organization.
The CFO will serve as a key member of the executive leadership team and strategic advisor to the CEO/President and Board, providing leadership across financial planning, insurance accounting, capital and solvency management, investment portfolio performance, asset-liability management, treasury, risk, regulatory reporting, and corporate development.
The successful candidate will combine deep financial expertise with strong commercial and investment acumen and will be capable of operating in a highly regulated financial-services environment.
Key Responsibilities
1. Financial Strategy & Executive Leadership
Develop and execute the organization's overall financial strategy.
Advise the CEO, President, and Board on financial performance, capital allocation, investment strategy, and enterprise value creation.
Translate corporate strategy into financial plans, budgets, forecasts, and measurable objectives.
Lead financial decision-making across insurance, investment, and corporate operations.
Establish strong financial governance and accountability across the organization.
2. Financial Planning, Budgeting & Performance
Lead annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-term financial planning.
Develop financial models and scenario analyses to support strategic decisions.
Monitor revenue, profitability, expenses, capital efficiency, and operating performance.
Establish financial KPIs and executive dashboards.
Identify opportunities to improve profitability, efficiency, and shareholder returns.
3. Insurance Finance & Performance
Oversee financial management of insurance operations, including premiums, claims, reserves, expenses, and underwriting performance.
Monitor key insurance financial metrics including loss ratios, combined ratios, expense ratios, and underwriting profitability.
Partner with actuarial, underwriting, claims, and risk teams to assess financial performance and emerging exposures.
Ensure appropriate financial treatment and reporting of insurance liabilities and reserves.
Support pricing, product profitability, reinsurance, and portfolio decisions from a financial perspective.
4. Investment Finance & Portfolio Management
Provide financial oversight of the organization's investment portfolio and investment activities.
Partner with the CIO/Chief Investment Officer and Investment Committee on portfolio strategy and performance.
Monitor investment income, realized/unrealized gains, asset allocation, liquidity, and risk-adjusted returns.
Evaluate investment opportunities and strategic asset-allocation decisions.
Ensure investment activities are aligned with the organization's liabilities, liquidity requirements, risk appetite, and regulatory requirements.
5. Capital, Solvency & Balance Sheet Management
Lead capital planning and balance-sheet optimization.
Monitor solvency, capital adequacy, liquidity, leverage, and financial resilience.
Develop strategies to optimize the organization's capital structure and return on capital.
Assess the financial impact of major business, investment, and insurance decisions on capital requirements.
Work closely with Risk and Actuarial functions on capital and solvency assessments.
6. Asset-Liability Management (ALM)
Provide executive financial oversight of asset-liability management.
Ensure investment portfolios are appropriately aligned with insurance liabilities and liquidity requirements.
Monitor duration, interest-rate sensitivity, liquidity gaps, and market exposures.
Support development of ALM strategies and balance-sheet optimization initiatives.
Ensure appropriate financial stress testing and scenario analysis.
7. Treasury & Liquidity
Oversee treasury, cash

title: Director of Revenue Operations
description:
Join ShopMy - Powering the Future of Digital Marketing

ShopMy is transforming e-commerce by building the infrastructure for human-led curation at scale. We help brands run performance-driven creator programs while enabling top creators to monetize their influence and partner directly with the brands they love-driving discovery through trusted tastemakers and authentic recommendations.

ShopMy recently became a unicorn, raising at a $1.5B valuation with backing from Bessemer Venture Partners, Avenir Growth Capital, and Bain Capital Ventures.

At ShopMy, you're building the future of human-led commerce for the world's best brands, tastemakers, and shoppers. You move fast and see immediate impact in your work, alongside accomplished teammates who are driven by helping find the world's best things. If you’re excited to help shape the future of curated commerce at the intersection of technology, culture, and taste, we’d love to meet you.

About the role

We are looking for a Director of Revenue Operations to own the planning, forecasting, and operational infrastructure behind our Success organization. You will help our Client Strategy and Enterprise teams retain brands, deepen product adoption, and grow subscription and performance revenue across the existing customer base.

Working directly with our Revenue Operations leader and closely with Success leadership, you will turn company priorities into goals, compensation plans, and practical ways of working. You will own an operational roadmap and carry initiatives from the initial question through implementation, team adoption, and measurable results.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys building. You are comfortable challenging an assumption, working through a detailed model, leading a business review, and partnering with technical teams to make a process better. You will have the opportunity to build the foundation for our next stage of growth and see your work make a difference in how teams operate every day.

What you'll own

• Planning & performance: Lead annual and quarterly Success planning. Turn revenue objectives into goals by segment, team, and account, and build models that connect retention, adoption, spend, and capacity.

• Forecasting: Own the Success forecast across renewals, expansion, churn, and performance products, including Opportunities and Spotlights. Standardize MRR and NRR definitions, run forecast reviews, and track accuracy.

• Compensation: Design and manage Success comp plans with Finance and People. Set measures, weightings, thresholds, and accelerators, model costs, and own rollout, documentation, and payout accuracy.

• Segmentation & capacity: Build balanced books across SMB, Growth, and Enterprise. Own coverage, rebalancing, and hiring/capacity models.

• Brand lifecycle: Standardize the process from Sales-to-Success handoff through onboarding, adoption, renewal, and expansion. Turn risk and growth signals into action, and operationalize pricing and packaging changes.

• Systems & reporting: Own the Success systems roadmap with the Salesforce and Data teams. Build dashboards and planning tools, use automation and AI to cut manual work, and set metric definitions teams trust.

• RevOps partnership: Act as Success's primary operational partner. Turn strategic questions into recommendations, run business reviews, and lead cross-functional initiatives end to end.

What we are looking for:

• 7+ years in RevOps, CS Ops, or BizOps, with real ownership of post-sale performance

• Have led planning, forecasting, retention analysis, and capacity modeling

• Have designed and rolled out variable comp plans

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). • Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD

We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

Join a fast-growing, engineering-driven software company known for building high-performance digital products used by millions worldwide. description:

POSITION SUMMARY
Sprezzatura is seeking a Security Automation / Cyber Security Engineer to support cybersecurity modernization for the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) VA.gov Platform.
The Security Automation / Data Engineer will design, develop, and implement automation that improves how security compliance data is collected, assessed, measured, and reported across a large-scale digital platform. This role will help transform repeatable, manual security and compliance activities into sustainable, engineering-driven capabilities that provide greater visibility into security posture and reduce the operational burden associated with maintaining compliance.
Working alongside security, DevSecOps, infrastructure, and product engineering teams, this position will focus on automated evidence collection and controls assessment, security data integration, compliance measurement, vulnerability and remediation reporting, Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) capabilities, and security posture dashboards.
The ideal candidate combines cybersecurity knowledge with strong automation and data engineering skills and is comfortable integrating information across cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, security tools, APIs, and compliance systems.
RESPONSIBILITIES

• Design, develop, and maintain automated processes for collecting security and compliance evidence from authoritative system, infrastructure, configuration, and security data sources

• Develop automation to support security control assessment and continuous monitoring, including OSCAL-based evidence collection and control-assessment capabilities

• Build integrations and data pipelines that aggregate and normalize security information from multiple tools, platforms, and APIs

• Develop security metrics and dashboards that provide near-real-time visibility into control posture, remediation status, vulnerabilities, and other security indicators

• Automate recurring security and compliance reporting for security teams, engineering teams, program leadership, and government stakeholders

• Develop capabilities for measuring security-control and security-tooling coverage across applications, infrastructure, and CI/CD pipelines

• Automate vulnerability and remediation reporting to support prioritization, ownership, aging analysis, and tracking through closure

• Support implementation and operation of an SBOM capability, including collection and analysis of software dependency and third-party component data

• Integrate SBOM and software supply-chain information with vulnerability management and security reporting capabilities

• Partner with DevSecOps Engineers to ensure security controls implemented within CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure generate usable, repeatable compliance evidence

• Identify manual security and compliance processes that are candidates for automation and implement scalable solutions where feasible

• Support the development of repeatable processes that enable product and engineering teams to demonstrate continued compliance with defined security standards

• Ensure automated security evidence, metrics, and reporting are traceable, maintainable, and usable during ongoing compliance activities and independent controls assessments

• Document automation, integrations, data sources, processes, and technical solutions to support long-term sustainment by the Platform Security team

• Collaborate with security engineers, cybersecurity/RMF specialists, DevSecOps engineers, software engineers, product teams, and government stakeholders

QUALIFICATIONS

• Associate's degree and four (4) years of relevant experience, or Bachelor's degree and two (2) years of relevant experience.

• Five (5) years of experience as a Cyber Security Engineer may be substituted in lieu of a degree

description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role
 
Warp Speed
Warp Speed builds on years of excellence in manufacturing to resurrect & revitalize the American Industrial Base. FDSEs on Warp Speed work directly with customers from the factory floor to the board room to understand their greatest problems and design and implement solutions using data.
 
As Forward Deployed Software Engineers (FDSEs) you’ll apply your problem solving ability, creativity, and technical skills to help organizations use their data to drive a real impact in the world. You’ll have the opportunity to gain rare insight into and contribute to some of the most important industries and institutions globally!
 
The Original Forward Deployed Software Engineer 
At Palantir, the Forward Deployed Software Engineer (FDSE) role isn’t just a job title: it’s the blueprint. We pioneered this unique position, embedding talented engineers directly with our customers to tackle their most pressing challenges head-on. As an FDSE, you’ll be at the intersection of world-changing problems and impactful technology, shaping solutions where they matter most.
 
FDSEs work side by side with our customers, rapidly understanding their toughest issues; architecting and building solutions that leverage business-critical data and the latest advancements in AI to solve them. Whether it’s “How do we predict and mitigate wildfire risks to optimize power grids?” or “How can we analyze and adapt a global food supply chain to deliver life-saving aid on time?”, you’ll use your technical expertise, creativity, and problem-solving skills to drive real-world impact.
 
You’ll have the rare opportunity to gain deep insight into and directly influence some of the world’s most critical industries and institutions. By building on Palantir’s powerful platforms leveraging integrated cutting-edge AI, you’ll help organizations unlock the full potential of their data to make smarter, faster decisions.
 
Core Responsibilities
 
As an FDSE, you’ll experience the autonomy of a startup, with the resources, mentorship, and stability of an established tech company. Your contributions will have a direct impact on our customers’ missions and the real world. You’ll work in small, agile teams and own the end-to-end execution and implementation of high-stakes projects, including:
 
• Collaborating with fellow engineers on architecture and design decisions
• Wrangling massive-scale data and using AI to accelerate and enhance critical operations
• Developing custom applications tailored to customer needs
• Engaging directly with customer stakeholders, from technical teams to executives
• Shaping team strategy and driving projects from ideation to deployment, increasing your pain threshold to deliver real value

Salary
 
The salary range for this position is estimated to be $10,000/month. Further note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual’s relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors. This estimate excludes the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long-term incentives.

Life at Palantir
 
We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. title: Manufacturing Auditor
description:
Manufacturing Auditor
📍 On-Site | Aerospace Manufacturing 💰 $28-$34/hour, depending on experience 🕐 Full-Time | Flexible Hours 🌟 Benefits Available
About the Role
A locally owned Aerospace Manufacturing Company is looking for an experienced Manufacturing Auditor to join our Engineering/Manufacturing team.
This is a hands-on quality role focused on ensuring manufacturing processes, inspection practices, and documentation meet customer and company standards. The ideal candidate has strong mechanical inspection experience, excellent GD&T and blueprint reading skills, and the confidence to work directly with machinists, supervisors, engineering, and management.
What You'll Do
Perform in-process and floor audits at CNC machines and throughout the manufacturing area.
Verify machinists are using the correct blueprint revisions, tooling, CNC programs, and Net-Inspect information.
Review parts and dimensions using precision inspection equipment.
Verify inspection tools and gauges-including micrometers, calipers, bore gauges, thread gauges, dial indicators, air gauges, and CNC probes-are properly calibrated and used.
Review SOPs, traveler routing sheets, and manufacturing processes for compliance.
Investigate first-article and inspection discrepancies using available measurement equipment.
Review previous quality issues, scrap information, SPC trends, and Net-Inspect data to identify potential problems.
Monitor 5S, safety, and FOD prevention throughout the manufacturing floor.
Document audit findings and maintain daily audit/shift records.
Participate in root cause analysis and CAPA activities, including the use of 5 Whys.
Communicate quality trends and recurring issues to machinists, programmers, shop foremen, Engineering, and Quality.
Help train employees on proper inspection equipment use and manufacturing principles.
What We're Looking For
Required:
5+ years of mechanical inspection experience
Strong GD&T and complex blueprint reading skills
Experience with precision measurement and inspection equipment
Knowledge of surface plate setup and inspection techniques
Strong understanding of shop math and mechanical principles
Ability to use and interpret SPC and Six Sigma tools
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
Ability to remain objective and unbiased when conducting audits
Preferred:
CMM experience
Knowledge of AS9100, ISO 9001, or AS9102
Experience with problem-solving and corrective action
CQT or CMI certification
Experience with Net-Inspect
Spanish language skills
The Right Person Will Be
🔍 Analytical - able to identify trends, investigate discrepancies, and determine root causes. 🤝 People-Oriented - comfortable working with employees at all levels while maintaining professionalism and tact. 🎯 Objective - able to conduct unbiased audits and focus on company and customer requirements. 🛠️ Hands-On - confident using inspection equipment and investigating manufacturing issues. 📣 A Strong Communicator - able to clearly explain findings, provide feedback, and help employees improve.
Work Environment
This position works in a machine shop/manufacturing environment with exposure to manufacturing equipment and noise. The role involves standing, walking, leaning, and occasional lifting of up to 10 lbs.
Drug-Free & Smoke-Free Workplace
If you're an experienced quality/inspection professional looking for a hands-on role in aerospace manufacturing, we'd love to hear from you!

title: Director, Area Asset Manager
description:
Who we are
For more than 40 years, Reworld has been a leader in sustainable waste solutions, providing our customers with innovative solutions that help them achieve carbon-negative outcomes.
Our Vision
Reworld is leading the charge to a carbon-negative future through revolutionary sustainable materials management solutions that reduce, reuse, recycle and reimagine waste for the benefit of society and the environment.
Our Business
Reworld partners with businesses by offering cutting-edge engineering and innovative solutions, to help customers reduce, reuse, recycle and recover value from waste streams and meet or exceed their sustainability goals.
Our Value
Reworld's differentiator comes from our ecosystem of technology, facilities and partnerships, trusted by the world’s largest organizations to reimagine waste management for a smarter, more sustainable world.
All that we’re missing is you. Apply today!
About the role
The Director, Area Asset Manager position will have responsibility for meeting and exceeding EBITDA and Free Cash Flow targets for the asset base under their direction. They will also lead asset management and development activities across a regional base of assets (primarily Energy-from-Waste facilities). The role entails direct oversight of revenue generating activities including service agreements, merchant waste as well as expense and capital items related to facility operations, improvements, and operational byproducts (residues). They will also have shared responsibilities in the areas of energy sales development and contracting, as well as residue management and revenue related thereof. Working closely with the Area Operations Manager, a significant part of the role is coordinating activities across operational, financial, energy, legal, business development, engineering, construction, environmental, government relations, and human resources disciplines and departments.
It is anticipated that the primary focus of the Director workload will be (i) regional financial performance, and (ii) regional asset development and asset improvement related activities that can further advance the entire company portfolio. Notable areas of identified opportunities include moving up the waste hierarchy, bolt on treatment technologies to support the growth of our Environmental Solutions (profiled) waste business, effective ash management/reuse, enhanced metals recovery, and enhancement of our energy portfolio capabilities (profitability/efficiency/diversity of energy production).
The Director must be able to originate and task a goal-oriented team of multi-disciplined managers in a way to harmoniously effectuate revenue growth and profit improvement of our asset base.
This role will be the principal point of contact for reporting and discussing financial performance of the asset base within their jurisdiction. The Director must be able to engage in constructive dialogue and have a sound decision making process to achieve success in the role and for the company. On regular occasions, the Director will report to the Chief Commercial Officer on assets and financial performance.

DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES
· Profit and Loss management

• Asset Improvement & Asset Development focused on revenue and margin growth

· Contract oversight & compliance

• Effective and prompt service delivery to Reworld customer base

• Implementation of market strategy, including merchant waste and client agreement contracting strategies

• Ability to manage and direct stakeholders at all levels - including internal and external senior executive and/or elected level decision makers.

· Risk management

• Strategy development, Business Development and/or strategy implementation

REQUIREMENTS (Education, Skills, Certificate, Licenses, Experience):
Education: Business degree or strong technical degree combined with a well-developed operating background required. MBA with a bachelor’s in engineering or business/ finance preferred.

title: Executive Operations Partner (EBP)
description:
ABOUT FACTORY

Our mission is to create a world where software builds and improves itself.

We build the platform for self-improving software development, helping the world's largest enterprise engineering teams turn their organizations into autonomous software factories. Customers including Nvidia, Blackstone, Royal Bank of Canada (RBC), Palo Alto Networks, Adobe, and T-Mobile run Factory to ship code, review PRs, run tests, and deploy continuously - getting smarter with every cycle.

In 2026, we raised $200M at a $5B valuation, bringing our total funding to over $400M. We are backed by world-class investors and operators including Khosla Ventures, Sequoia, Blackstone, Ali Ghodsi (CEO of Databricks), and Frank Slootman (Former CEO of Snowflake).

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking a highly organized and execution-oriented professional to join our Executive Operations Team. In this role, you will be the right hand to our COO and will work closely with the CEO’s Executive Operations Partner.

This is a dynamic role in a high agency environment that requires swift and pragmatic decision making, an ability to navigate complex stakeholder relationships, and a hunger to build as Factory scales rapidly. As an early member of the ExecOps team, you will help define what operational excellence looks like and become a deeply embedded partner with your respective teams.

This role will initially provide dedicated support to the COO. As the business grows and additional senior leaders join, the role may expand to support one additional executive, with the COO remaining your primary executive.

WHAT YOU WILL DO AND ACHIEVE:

- Act as a strategic force multiplier for the leadership team, building deep business context and applying sound judgment to keep priorities moving.

- Approach problems with an ownership mindset, coming with a recommendation and seeking alignment rather than answers when issues arise.

- Stand up and continuously improve new processes as Factory scales, raising the bar on how the company operates day to day.

- Build strong cross-functional relationships, staying informed on what's happening on the ground and serving as a trusted point of contact for peers and leaders.

- Operate as a gate opener rather than a gatekeeper, ensuring teams know they can come to you and leaders stay accessible rather than walled off.

- Own end-to-end interactions with candidates, customers, investors, and board members, ensuring communications are prompt and polished.

- Plan and coordinate logistics for high-stakes meetings, trips, and events, ensuring they are well-prepared and run smoothly.

- Own the core operational competencies for each of your leaders including calendars, travel, meeting prep, expenses, and logistics.

QUALIFICATIONS

- Extremely organized and accountable; skilled at managing multiple competing priorities.

- Proactive; you identify gaps, conflicts, and risks before they become issues.

- Highly responsive; comfortable with regular text communication and quick decision-making.

- Detail-oriented with exceptional accuracy and follow-through.

- A confident communicator who represents leadership with professionalism and discretion.

- Comfortable with ambiguity, autonomy, and scaling systems in a startup environment.

- Tech-savvy with proficiency in Slack, Notion, CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), Ramp, and other productivity tools.

NICE TO HAVE

- Prior experience supporting C-level executives or founders.

- Startup, tech, or AI industry exposure.

- Experience at Series B, Series C, or growth-stage companies.
